mapper.select: SELECT id FROM supplier_payment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_dispute_resolution WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{id} ORDER BY resolved_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_payment_operation SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},dispatches=#{dispatches},highest_revision=#{highestRevision},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND command_json=#{commandJson} AND command_digest=#{digest}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_payment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM supplier_payment_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT version,state_json FROM supplier_payment_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} ORDER BY version

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_payment_operation q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE (q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('CHECKING','SENDING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT version,state_json FROM supplier_payment_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{parameters[0]} AND operation_id=#{parameters[1]} AND version<=#{parameters[2]} ORDER BY version
